title: How Texas got here on the 765-kV lines
subtitle: From Winter Storm Uri to five applications now pending at the Public Utility Commission
alt: Timeline of the Texas 765-kilovolt transmission line buildout, from Winter Storm Uri in 2021 to pending Public Utility Commission decisions in 2026

events.label: Winter Storm Uri forces rolling blackouts
events.note: 246 deaths; $80 billion to $130 billion in economic damage

events.label: House Bill 5066 becomes law
events.note: Cuts the PUC's review window for a line from 365 days to 180

events.label: West Texas demand outruns the rest of the state
events.note: West Zone demand up 12.3% vs. 6.1% statewide; congestion up 27%

events.label: ERCOT testifies on Permian Basin reliability
events.note: Its COO said rolling blackouts there are possible by next summer

events.label: Abbott orders an audit of data centers in the queue
events.note: ERCOT pauses its Batch Zero study of large-load connections

events.label: State hearings office recommends rejecting a leg
events.note: First time SOAH has done so for this buildout

next.label: PUC rules on five pending applications
next.note: Final decisions expected in the next couple of months
